title: Optimal single-track Gray codes from Gray-ordered necklaces
summary: A single-track Gray code of length $n$ is a cyclic Gray code of $n$-bit words in which every column is a cyclic shift of the first. For prime $n$ the longest possible period is $2^n-2$. Whether it is attained for every prime has been open since Hiltgen, Paterson and Brandestini introduced these codes in 1996, and optimal codes were known for primes $n\le 19$. We show that a conjecture of Degni and Drisko (2007) on the reflected Gray code order of necklaces implies optimal single-track Gray codes for every prime.
